_comment: Dotted-path keys, same convention gsd-core's federated-config.cjs uses for its schema keys. sync-gsd-config.mjs writes each key into the target repo's .planning/config.json at that exact path, leaving every other key untouched. Verified with a dry-run against all 5 platform repos, not just guessed from two samples: workflow.ui_phase/ui_safety_gate and code_quality.fallow.* were dropped after the dry-run showed they are deliberately false/absent in replays-fetcher, replay-parser-2 and infrastructure (no UI, or non-TS stack) — those are repo-type-specific, not universal. mempalace.cross_project_tunnels is a deliberate override of gsd-core's own default (false) — SolidStats is a genuinely multi-repo platform (see shared/AGENTS.md's MemPalace section) and wants tunnels on everywhere, unlike the single-service default gsd-core assumes. Per-repo overrides that stay local: workflow.ai_integration_phase, workflow.skip_discuss, workflow.use_worktrees, workflow.ui_phase, workflow.ui_safety_gate, workflow.ui_review, workflow.test_command, code_quality.fallow.*, mempalace.capture_artifacts, mempalace.mirror_kg, mempalace.auto_capture_hooks, project_code, agent_skills, and anything else absent from this file.
